title: Tardigrade: Prithvi Ka Sabse Immortal Micro Organism! 🦠 #shorts
idea: Explaining how the microscopic Tardigrade survives extreme temperatures and the vacuum of space.

lines.text: Prithvi par ek aisa micro organism hai jo antariksh mein bhi zinda rehta hai!
Iska naam hai Tardigrade, jo minus 272 degree Celsius ki thand sehan kar sakta hai.
Itna hi nahi, yeh plus 149 degree Celsius ki khaufnaak garmi mein bhi bachta hai!
Bina khane aur paani ke yeh kayi saalon tak aaram se reh sakta hai.
2007 mein scientists ne ise space ke zero oxygen vacuum mein 10 din rakha!
Phir bhi yeh zinda mila, kya aapko lagta hai aliens micro level par maujood hain?

youtube.description:
Kya aap jante hain Tardigrade space mein bhi zinda reh sakta hai? Minus 272 degree ki thand ho ya space ka vacuum, yeh har jagah bacha rehta hai!

#tardigrade #facts #spacefacts #sciencefacts #hinglish

facts.claim: Tardigrades can tolerate temperatures down to minus 272 degrees Celsius and up to plus 149 degrees Celsius.
Tardigrades survived 10 days of space vacuum exposure in 2007.
